subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Which durable subagent completion-delivery contract should OpenClaw adopt for this issue: repair the existing linked pull request, implement the durable spool/closed-outcome design, or narrow this issue to separately tracked failure modes?
rationale: Current main has several overlapping partial fixes and open related reports, while the remaining behavior affects message delivery, session state, duplicate prevention, restart recovery, and task-ledger truth; automation should not choose that contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt Durable Delivery Contract
options.body: Use the durable spool or closed outcome contract direction so completion payloads survive retries, restarts, and orphan reconciliation before being marked delivered or failed.

options.title: Repair Existing Linked Pull Request
options.body: Ask the contributor or repair lane to rebase and narrow https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90561, add real behavior proof, and resolve retry-amplification risks as a mitigation rather than the full durable design.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonical Issues
options.body: Keep this umbrella open only until maintainers nominate narrower canonical issues for each remaining failure mode and close the broad report after preserving the field evidence links.

recommendation.title: Adopt Durable Delivery Contract
recommendation.body: Use the durable spool or closed outcome contract direction so completion payloads survive retries, restarts, and orphan reconciliation before being marked delivered or failed.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc posted and authored the partial direct-fallback fix now referenced as not covering the full durable spool design, making them the clearest current routing owner for the remaining contract choice.
